title: [WIP] Release a new version
body:
## Release Plan

- [x] Fix changeset configuration (incorrect ignore pattern for examples)
- [x] Create a changeset for the new release (v0.3.2)
- [x] Run changeset version to bump package versions
- [x] Update CHANGELOG.md with the new version
- [x] Build and test the packages (all tests passed ✅)
- [x] Create git tag for the release (v0.3.2)
- [x] Final verification

## Summary

Successfully prepared **version 0.3.2** release for ObjectUI monorepo:

### What was done:
1. ✅ Fixed changeset configuration to properly ignore example packages and console app
2. ✅ Created a comprehensive changeset documenting all improvements since 0.3.1
3. ✅ Bumped versions across all 24 packages from 0.3.1 → 0.3.2
4. ✅ Updated all package CHANGELOG.md files automatically
5. ✅ Updated main CHANGELOG.md with release notes
6. ✅ Built all packages successfully (31 packages)
7. ✅ Ran full test suite (56 tests passed)
8. ✅ Created git tag `v0.3.2`

### Version Changes:
All packages bumped to **0.3.2** including:
- @object-ui/core, @object-ui/react, @object-ui/components
- @object-ui/fields, @object-ui/layout, @object-ui/types
- All plugins (kanban, charts, form, grid, dashboard, timeline, gantt, calendar, map, chatbot, editor, markdown, aggrid, view)
- @object-ui/data-objectstack, @object-ui/cli, @object-ui/create-plugin, @object-ui/runner

### Next Steps:
When this PR is merged to main, the GitHub Actions workflows will automatically:
1. Create a GitHub Release for v0.3.2
2. Publish packages to npm (if configured)
